facts.value: At the Kemmy Business School (KBS) you’ll find a vibrant research environment with faculty who are leaders in their field, and where there is a strong focus on students engaging in translational research – research that has impact and consequences for organisational change and public policy.
Research students develop advanced skills in designing and conducting research; skills applicable to a variety of careers in academia, business, government and non-profit organisations.
All research students are key members of our four cutting-edge research themes under the umbrella theme of 'Organisation Science and Public Policy'.
Students can apply and register at any stage of the academic year for a research degree, both part-time and full-time, as applications are considered monthly during the academic year.
Upon graduation many KBS graduates take up senior academic posts, or secure positions with government or private sector organisations.
A research degree from the KBS will give you an opportunity to make an impact.
